findings.claim: Shipped HYBRID type-name P@1 is capped at 0.755 (lexical ceiling 0.945) because the 659 node entries are NOT in the semantic index. scout fuses lexical BM25 + a prose-only dense index with RRF, and an un-embedded node that is lexical-rank-1 can never beat a prose doc that is dense-rank-1 AND present in lexical: 1/61 < 1/(60+r) + 1/61. So ~32 type queries that lexical resolves correctly are lost to dense-injected prose.
findings.proven_fix: Embed the 659 node searchable_texts with the same all-MiniLM-L6-v2/dim-384 embedder and add them to rag/semantic_index (1.5s encode, +~1MB embeddings.npy). MEASURED result: hybrid P@1 0.99, floor 0.998, disambiguation 1.0, served_phantom 0.0 - BUT conceptual recall regresses 0.8333 -> 0.6667 (queries 'crowds' and 'build a layered shader network' now surface node entries above the intended concept docs; still above test_gate6's 0.333 release floor). See spawn S1.
findings.why_not_here: rag/semantic_index/ + scripts/build_semantic_index.py + scout.py are OUTSIDE W4-KNOW's declared touches; the fix is a committed binary artifact with a conceptual-recall trade-off that merits a human ruling; and the recon sequences semantic/storage work as a later step. Shipped in-scope: the corpus fix maximises the lexical ceiling and makes nodes visible (predicate 1).

findings.claim: Serve-size envelope shift (disclosed, not silent - crucible criterion). Target 5's uncapping makes knowledge_lookup node datasheets far larger than scout's ~495B mean / 966B max snippet envelope. This is a DIFFERENT surface (a full datasheet, not a truncated scout snippet) and the mission explicitly required uncapping.
findings.note: MEASURED per response and reported via serve_bytes; never estimated. A future storage leg (recon step 3, SQLite+FTS5) can bound the wire size without re-capping the served fields.

spawn.name: embed the H22 node corpus into the semantic index so scout's dense path ranks nodes
spawn.held_for: Joe (build class is outside W4-KNOW spawn_classes=[probe]; also carries a conceptual-recall trade-off + a committed binary artifact that need a human ruling)
spawn.rationale: The value gate on the SHIPPED HYBRID scout: proven to lift type-name P@1 0.755->0.99 and floor 0.953->0.998. Without it, an agent grounding in the live (torch-present) Houdini session gets 0.755 P@1; the in-scope corpus fix only opens the gate on the lexical-only path (0.945).
targets: 1) embed the 659 node searchable_texts with the committed embedder (all-MiniLM-L6-v2, dim 384) and extend rag/semantic_index (embeddings.npy + meta.jsonl + manifest entries count + content_digest) via scripts/build_semantic_index.py - reproducibly, not a hand-appended npy

2) preserve conceptual recall: a blind append regresses it 0.8333->0.6667. Prefer a placement that does not - e.g. a SEPARATE node-dense index consulted only on type/symbol intent, or down-weighting node vectors for conceptual queries in scout.py's RRF
3) re-run scout_eval (original + run_type_name_eval) + test_gate6; P@1>=0.98 AND conceptual_topk_hitrate does not drop below the pre-embed 0.8333
